fullDiskAccess.title: Grant Full Disk Access
fullDiskAccess.description:
To browse all your files without access prompts, grant Wisp Full Disk Access:

1. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access
2. Toggle Wisp ON
3. Restart Wisp

Without this, macOS will prompt you each time you open protected folders like Photos, Documents, or iCloud Drive.
